summary: No active concrete experiment-integrity mismatch found. Retained COCO metrics, GT, split isolation, frozen source and cache bridge reproduce; claims are appropriately limited.

A.name: Ground-truth provenance
A.details: All 5,000 manifest image IDs exactly equal official COCO val2017 annotation IDs; every manifest ground-truth box/class/crowd/annotation ID matches the annotation source, and every cached GT matches the manifest. Original-image AP uses pycocotools.COCOeval. No model output becomes ground truth. SICE is explicitly not_run with no reference PSNR/SSIM.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details: IoU uses intersection over union; recall uses noncrowd GT counts; precision uses TP+FP; FP/image includes all evaluated images. No reported accuracy metric is divided by prediction max/min/mean. Raw COCO AP and operating-point metrics are separate. Image quality uses fixed 255 scaling and descriptive pixel statistics, expressly not exposure truth.

C.name: Result existence, numbers and completion
C.details: All 5,990 expected unique cache artifacts exist, with no extra/missing keys or identity mismatches; they contain 5,790 non-reused forwards and 200 exact reused prediction arrays with zero inference_ms. All original and 36 diagnostic operating summaries, all three official AP summaries, the complete calibration object, development policy, fixed-0.35 test comparison and public quality aggregates reproduce. The public engineering log counts match. The one initially stale UI hash is superseded by a separately preserved final node verification whose seven hashes and log hash match current files.

D.name: Metric reachability and execution
D.details: All in-scope detection, calibration, quality-failure and latency metric functions are invoked by the evaluator and have outputs in real result files. Official COCOeval is called directly; hand-checked duplicate/crowd/empty-image/sparse-calibration/single-box AP tests cover meaningful metric boundaries. No claimed PSNR/SSIM or other dead metric was found.

E.name: Scope, configurations and isolation
E.details: Evidence is one public COCO validation corpus, one split seed (20261023), 3,000/1,000/1,000 images, and 30 diagnostic base images per split under four variants and three methods. The text correctly distinguishes 360 correlated test rows from 30 independent base images, acknowledges public-data and scene-independence limits, 58 insufficient classes, 10/22 calibrated classes below 0.8 test precision, and SICE/real-LLM/RAG accuracy not evaluated. Freeze precedes retained test cache mtimes and all test signatures are frozen-current; old archives contain no test rows.

F.name: Evaluation-type classification
F.details: COCO original detection and its calibration/test operating metrics are real_gt. Digital brightness/blackout experiments are simulation_only input experiments, with dataset GT retained for COCO detector scoring; they are not model-generated-reference synthetic_proxy. Image-only exposure/quality indicators and scripted workflow equivalence are self_supervised_proxy/engineering checks, not human_eval or semantic accuracy. SICE is not_run and real LLM acceptance is not_run.
